description: Offline embeddings, the LLM gateway (mock default, OpenRouter gated with required model id, fallback chain), and the LangGraph four-agent pipeline (Search -> Summarize -> Writer -> Verify) with bounded deterministic retries and end-to-end source attribution. This is the core workflow engine. Depends on FEAT-001 (config, logging). FEAT-003/004/005 depend on this.
steps: Create app/memory/__init__.py and app/memory/embeddings.py: embed(text) -> np.ndarray as a deterministic hashed-token projection to a fixed 256-dim L2-normalized vector, and cosine(a, b). Network-free; shared later by LTM and cache; docs note it is not a semantic model.

Create app/gateway/: base.py (LLMGateway Protocol with async complete(*, agent, system, prompt) -> GatewayResult where GatewayResult carries text/provider/model/fallback_used), mock.py (MockGateway, deterministic output from a seeded hash, provider='mock', never emits citation-looking strings for sources not present, no network), tensorzero_gw.py (TensorZeroGateway wrapping AsyncTensorZeroGateway.build_embedded, import-guarded tensorzero, constructed only when resolution selects openrouter, model_name from QUERYN_OPENROUTER_MODEL, credentials from OPENROUTER_API_KEY, never picks a model itself), fallback.py (FallbackGateway wrapping an ordered list; on TimeoutError/provider exception/injected failure moves to next, sets fallback_used=True, records the event; plus a FlakyMockGateway for offline failure injection), factory.py (build_gateway(settings) returns FallbackGateway([MockGateway()]) by default, FallbackGateway([TensorZeroGateway(...), MockGateway()]) when OpenRouter is configured).

Create app/graph/state.py: ResearchState TypedDict total=False with fields per design.md (query, mode dict[str,str|bool], sources, findings, knowledge, draft, claims, verify_findings, verified, retries, max_retries, termination, provider_calls, error) using an append reducer (Annotated + operator.add) on sources and provider_calls; plus Source/Finding/KnowledgePoint/Claim/VerifyFinding structures. Source is the only producer of ids; downstream references by id; Writer attaches source_ids to each claim.

Create app/search/: base.py (SearchProvider Protocol search(query) -> list[Source]) and mock.py (deterministic synthetic sources seeded by a hash of the query, every source mock=True with a mock:// URI and title/snippet prefixed [SIMULATED SOURCE]; always returns at least one source).

Create app/agents/ (search, summarize, writer, verify, plus __init__.py): agents are (state)->dict and obtain model text only through the injected LLMGateway. Implement the shared metric in verify.py (or a shared module): tokens(s) lowercases and splits on runs of non-alphanumerics dropping empties; containment(text, reference) = fraction of text tokens present in reference; a claim is supported iff some resolving source snippet has containment >= 0.5. The mock Writer copies source-snippet tokens verbatim into each claim so a normal run verifies on the first pass. Verify sets only verified and verify_findings and never touches retries.

Create app/graph/build.py: StateGraph with nodes search, summarize, bump_retries, writer, verify and static edges START->search->summarize->writer->verify; a pure route_after_verify(state) returning finalize_verified if verified, finalize_exhausted if retries >= max_retries, else bump_retries; bump_retries returns {retries: retries+1} and has a static edge to writer; finalize_verified and finalize_exhausted set termination then flow to END. Bind collaborators into node callables via functools.partial/closures. Compile the graph.

Create app/graph/runner.py: seed the initial ResearchState as {query, mode, retries: 0, max_retries: settings.max_verify_retries, verified: False} before invoking (carry-forward requirement), set recursion_limit = 5 + 3*max_retries + 2, catch GraphRecursionError and finalize termination='failed' returning the best available draft, and map the final state to a result object.

Create tests/unit/test_embeddings.py, tests/unit/test_gateway.py, tests/unit/test_routing.py, tests/unit/test_agents.py, tests/integration/__init__.py, tests/integration/test_pipeline.py covering the acceptance criteria below.
acceptance_criteria: Embedding is deterministic for a given input and cosine behaves correctly (identical=1.0, orthogonal~0.0)
With no provider configured the gateway selects mock; enabling OpenRouter without QUERYN_OPENROUTER_MODEL surfaces a configuration error rather than defaulting a model
An injected gateway failure engages the fallback and sets fallback_used=True, recorded in provider_calls
The first route_after_verify call on the seeded initial state raises no KeyError
A normal offline run terminates verified with at least one attributed source, every source mock-labeled [SIMULATED SOURCE]/mock://
A forced disjoint-token fixture terminates max_retries_exhausted after exactly max_retries revisions and never loops indefinitely
uv run mypy app/gateway app/memory/embeddings.py app/graph app/agents app/search reports no errors
No file created in this feature contains a comment or docstring
verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_embeddings.py tests/unit/test_gateway.py tests/unit/test_routing.py tests/unit/test_agents.py tests/integration/test_pipeline.py
uv run mypy app/gateway app/memory/embeddings.py app/graph app/agents app/search
findings: Implemented app/memory/embeddings.py (256-dim hashed-token L2-normalized embed + cosine; cosine clamped to [-1,1] so identical vectors return exactly 1.0), app/gateway/ (base GatewayResult dataclass + LLMGateway Protocol, MockGateway + FlakyMockGateway, TensorZeroGateway via AsyncTensorZeroGateway.build_embedded with import-guarded tensorzero and model from QUERYN_OPENROUTER_MODEL, FallbackGateway with events list + AllGatewaysFailedError, factory.build_gateway), app/graph/state.py (ResearchState TypedDict total=False with operator.add reducers on sources and provider_calls; Source/Finding/KnowledgePoint/Claim/VerifyFinding/ProviderCall TypedDicts), app/search/ (SearchProvider Protocol + MockSearchProvider seeding snippets from query tokens, all mock://+[SIMULATED SOURCE]), app/agents/ (search/summarize/writer as module-level async funcs taking collaborators via keyword, bound with functools.partial in build.py; verify_node sync + shared tokens()/containment(text, reference) threshold 0.5; mock writer copies source snippet verbatim into claim text so normal run verifies first pass), app/graph/build.py (route_after_verify pure, bump_retries sole writer of retries, finalize nodes set termination), app/graph/runner.py (ResearchRunner seeds {query,mode,retries:0,max_retries,verified:False}; recursion_limit=5+3*max_retries+2; catches GraphRecursionError -> termination='failed'; returns RunResult dataclass). DECISIONS/NOTES for later steps: (1) No api/schemas.py yet (FEAT-003 owns ResearchResult); runner returns a local RunResult dataclass. FEAT-003 should map RunResult (report/sources/claims/verify_findings/verified/termination/mode/provider_calls) to the API ResearchResult and may inject ResearchRunner. (2) Agent nodes are module-level async functions (search_node, summarize_node, writer_node) bound via functools.partial(provider=/gateway=); verify_node and bump_retries/finalize nodes are sync. This shape was required so mypy accepts add_node overloads for async nodes. (3) build_gateway returns FallbackGateway; its .events list records per-attempt {agent,provider,outcome[,error]} and is the fallback audit trail for tracing in later features. (4) ProviderCall TypedDict added to state for append-reducer typing. (5) No pyproject/version bumps were needed; fpdf2 remained 2.8.2 (already pinned). Verification run from worktree root: pytest (targeted 22 passed; full suite 32 passed), mypy on app/gateway app/memory/embeddings.py app/graph app/agents app/search clean, ruff check . clean. No comments/docstrings in any created file.
